description:
Farm Steam trading cards, manage achievements, and idle games automatically — an all-in-one alternative to ArchiSteamFarm, Steam Achievement Manager, and Idle Master

Steam Game Idler (SGI) is a Steam automation tool for farming trading cards, managing achievements, and boosting playtime across all games in your Steam library.
## What's Changed
• refactor(dashboard)：redesign main sidebar and settings panel sidebar by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2190
• build(tauri)：stop no-change rebuilds and drop unused mobile crate types by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2192
• refactor：unify site and app branding by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2195
• refactor：roll out the new logo across the app, site and repo assets by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2196
• refactor(ui)：drop beta tags from card farming settings by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2198


**Full Changelog**：https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/compare/6.2.13...6.3.0
